descFull: Free, open-source anti-detect browser. A Chromium 157 fork that spoofs the fingerprint in C++ rather than with injected JavaScript, with per-profile personas and proxies, a built-in MCP server for AI assistants, and a self-hostable team server with per-project access. No seats, no per-profile pricing, no telemetry.
